name: tama-kit
description: Bootstrap apps, provision MCP App OAuth, and build, manage, and audit Tama Terraform graphs.

interface.longDescription: Bootstrap standard applications, assess, implement, and provision MCP App OAuth providers with a local Tama runtime, then design, extend, migrate, remove, and audit complete Tama Terraform graphs for global foundations, conversations, direct actions, ingestion, indexing, and reprocessing.
capabilities: Bootstrap standard apps and MCP App provider integrations
Assess and implement OAuth providers for Tama MCP App
Build and modify Tama Terraform graphs
Audit Tama graph wiring and lifecycle safety
defaultPrompt: Integrate my app with Tama and provision MCP App OAuth when required.
Safely extend or migrate this Tama graph.
Audit this Tama graph for incomplete or unsafe wiring.
